verdict.rationale: Google Drive API documents OAuth scopes for authorization, including a narrow least-privilege scope ('See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app') alongside broader scopes, which lets a developer restrict an agent's access to only files it creates/opens. However, there's no agent-specific credential-issuance flow (e.g., short-lived tokens, service-account delegation tailored to AI agents, or per-agent key management UI) beyond generic OAuth scope configuration in the Cloud console. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential provisioning workflow, examples of issuing distinct scoped credentials per agent instance, and independent/hands-on confirmation that least-privilege scopes work reliably for agentic use cases.
